brief: Rank catalog-derived finalists from the full 1,800-record Web Surfers library.
hermes_task:

Treat the supplied catalog descriptions/pricing as catalog-grounded facts; mark API/MCP/CLI feasibility as inferred/unknown unless obvious from the product type. Optimize for: revenue generation/protection, business automation, research quality, fire/grant/geospatial work, coaching/content workflows, media production, data analysis, and realistic integration into ChatGPT/Nicholas-AI-OS.
